policy: Profiles are original conditional guidance informed by primary interviews and research. Attributions are bounded by actual access. Named engineers are selected examples, not a ranking or endorsement. No paid lesson, unheard audio, exact secret chain or universal preset is claimed.

sources.speaker: Jan-Peter Herbst and Eric Smialek (research authors)
sources.title: Mixed Results: An Introduction to Analyzing Music Production through Eight Commissioned Metal Mixes
sources.access: public primary-research PDF text; methodology and aesthetic framework read
sources.scope: Same-song comparative study involving Bogren, Exeter, Getgood, Middleton, Nordström, Odeholm, Otero and Scheps; multiple viable production aesthetics.
sources.limits: One commissioned song and a limited cohort, not all metal; the complete audio/video corpus was not auditioned.
